description: Gaps found while building the probe registry (spikes/phase0-probe/src/models/registry.json): (1) no ONNX export exists for Moonshine Streaming Tiny or any per-language Moonshine Streaming Small checkpoint (ja etc.); (2) Moonshine Streaming Medium only has a community dynamic-int8 export — produce fp16/fp32 for WebNN NPU/GPU placement; (3) Whisper/Moonshine *merged* decoders are a single If node (use_cache_branch) and WebNN has no If op — benchmark non-merged decoder_with_past graphs instead; (4) catalog entries use community exports — pin revisions + hashes once chosen. Use optimum / the upstream exporters; add each to registry.json and run the models inspect/fixtures tooling.
title: Produce missing/WebNN-friendly ONNX exports for catalog models
